model.name: Manage panel shows current repo, local path, current branch and available worktrees, each switchable
model.description: The dialog's MANAGE panel shows, for the current repo: the local server path, the current branch, and the available worktrees. RATIFIED D3: selecting a worktree is a READ-ONLY ref-pick (worktree-as-key) - the server does NOT checkout or mutate any working tree; the pick repoints the READ key so diff/header read that worktree's ref. Consistent with R30.40 (the oosh root follows HOME/oosh). Shared enabler = dynamic/persisted RepoRegistry; architect derives impl-units.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The MANAGE panel shows, for the current repo: local server path, current branch, and the list of available worktrees.

RATIFIED D3: each worktree is SELECTABLE as a READ-ONLY key (worktree-as-key) - selecting one repoints the READ key so diff/header read that worktree ref; the server performs NO checkout and mutates NO working tree.
After a switch, the center header + diff reflect the newly-selected worktree's branch (dynamic, per R30.40).
RATIFIED D3: switching only selects among the repo OWN worktrees as read keys (bounded) - no server checkout, no arbitrary path.
RATIFIED D3+D4: a worktree SWITCH is READ-ONLY (D3) so requires NO admin-key; any MUTATING manage action (register/remove from the registry) requires the admin-key (D4).
GATE (DET-3x + Tron visual): open manage -> shows path+branch+worktrees; switch a worktree -> header/diff track it; client-facing -> version-bump.

model.securitySurface: SECURITY SURFACE RATIFIED by Tron D1-D4 (2026-07-19): D1 path-bounds = HOME-subtree + REPO_ALLOW, realpath-checked; D2 clone SSRF = host-allowlist (github.com+team) + https/ssh only (reject file/git/ext); D3 worktree switch = READ-ONLY ref-pick, worktree-as-key, NO server checkout; D4 auth = admin-key for ALL writes (register/clone/registry-mutation). Read-only actions need no admin-key.
